name: PM Jan Dhan Yojana
summary: Basic savings bank account for financial inclusion with no minimum balance requirement.

name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
summary: Low-cost accident insurance providing coverage for accidental death and disability.

name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
summary: Renewable one-year life insurance scheme providing coverage on death due to any cause.

name: Atal Pension Yojana
summary: Pension scheme providing a guaranteed minimum monthly pension from age 60 based on contributions.

name: PM SVANidhi
summary: Collateral-free working-capital loans and related support for eligible street vendors.

name: Mudra Loans
summary: Collateral-free institutional credit for micro enterprises engaged in non-agricultural income-generating activities.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
summary: Government-backed savings scheme that can be opened by a guardian in the name of a girl child below 10 years of age.
